## Release — backlog-campaign v0.27.2

### ✨ What's new in v0.27.2

#### The status page is published when a run starts

- A `run` now publishes or refreshes the campaign's status page before its first worker is spawned. Before, only the printed text dashboard was part of the run's start, so a campaign could go through bootstrap, forge sync and several waves without a status page, and nothing said so ([#1138](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1138)).
- The refresh also happens when the main chat hands the turn back while workers are still running. A busy campaign never reaches a moment with no worker in flight, so the page used to go stale for as long as the campaign stayed busy.
- The same step now appears in every place a run is walked: the skill's bootstrap and orchestration lists, the coordinator's launch form and resume gate, and the Claude Code orchestrator's bootstrap.
- `bun run verify` gains `V-STATUSPAGE-01`, which fails when any of those sections stops pointing at the status-page procedure, so the step cannot quietly drop out of a run again.

#### Pull requests held for you appear under "Waiting on you"

- When the campaign reaches LGTM on a pull request but leaves the merge to you (a workflow, security or other high-risk change), the status page now lists it under **Waiting on you**, with the reason it is held and a link to review it. Before, only pull requests delivered in `leave-open` mode were listed there, so in the other merge modes the list could stay empty while several pull requests waited for you ([#1141](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/issues/1141)).
- A held pull request is no longer shown as work in progress, and a campaign whose only open work is held pull requests reports that it is waiting on you.
